SELECT A.MEMB_CODE as MembNoL,A.MEMB_NAME As MembNameL,A.AC_MOBILE AS MobileL,A.SCHM_CODE AS SchemeL ,A.MEMB_AMT AS SchmAmtR,FORMAT(SUM(IIF(SIGN = '+',B.ADJ_AMT,- B.ADJ_AMT)),'0.00') AS MembBalR FROM AD_MEMB AS A LEFT JOIN AD_OS AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,A.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_AMT,A.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_CODE

' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ?
